name: Mosaic
tagline: The AI workspace that works for you.
description: A clean, modern marketing site for an AI-workspace / productivity SaaS — a long bento-driven home page with a browser-chrome product preview, a scrolling logo wall, agent and assistant showcases, social proof and stats, plus Pricing, Enterprise, a Request-a-demo page, two customer stories with a Customers index, and brand-voiced welcome + product-tips emails. Near-monochrome apex theme with a playful bento accent palette. Installs as a draft for the tenant to review, customize, and publish.
